instruction: A candid sports photograph with a medium full shot captures two squash players on an indoor court with wooden flooring and white walls. On the left, the blonde woman in the black skirt (R2) stands in profile facing right, smiling as she raises her left hand. On the right, the man with the white headband (R1) stands facing her, raising his right hand to meet hers in a high-five. Both players hold wooden squash rackets in their opposite hands. The scene is illuminated by bright, even indoor lighting, highlighting the clean athletic attire and the red boundary lines on the background wall.
